official: 中野区指定障害児入所施設等の人員、設備及び運営の基準等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案一覧

name: 障害児入所施設に性暴力防止措置を求める
summary: 中野区の指定障害児入所施設には、人員や設備、運営に関する基準があります。この議案では、障害児への性暴力などを防ぎ、起きた場合に保護するため、対象業務に従事する人の犯罪事実確認などを施設設置者に求めます。施行日は2026年12月25日です。
changes: 対象業務に従事する人の犯罪事実確認など、必要な措置を求める
性暴力等が起きた場合に障害児を適切に保護する措置を定める
who: 指定福祉型障害児入所施設を運営する事業者
指定福祉型障害児入所施設に入所する障害児
why: 児童福祉法に基づく指定障害児入所施設等の基準改正に伴い、条例の規定を整える必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Requires measures to prevent sexual violence at facilities for children with disabilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nakano City Ordinance on Standards for Staffing, Facilities and Operations of Designated Facilities for Children with Disabilities, etc.
en.summary: Designated facilities for children with disabilities in Nakano City must meet standards for staffing, facilities and operations. This bill requires facility operators to take measures such as checking the criminal records of people engaged in work covered by the rules, to prevent sexual violence against children with disabilities and protect them if it occurs. The ordinance will take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require measures such as checking the criminal records of people engaged in work covered by the rules
Set out measures to appropriately protect children with disabilities if sexual violence or similar incidents occur
who: Operators of designated welfare-type residential facilities for children with disabilities
Children with disabilities residing in designated welfare-type residential facilities
en.why: The ward says the ordinance needs to be updated because the standards for designated facilities for children with disabilities, etc. under the Child Welfare Act have been revised.
